name: Archie queue doctor (Mergify batch culprits, unqueued approved PRs, conductor/GitHub disagreements)

knobs.note: BH-4584: 0 stops the tick before any read. Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-fm-queue.log and the default. The per-project switch is the settings row archie.manage[.<project>] = on|observe|off, shared with archie-fm.

BH-4584: seconds after which a `started` archie_actions row this lane left behind (a tick that died) is closed failed with ONE ALERTS line. It is never reclaimed: a queue action recurs on a new key (new head, batch or main tip) or not at all. Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_RETRY_S:-1800}; outside 60..86400 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4584: projects read per tick; each tick starts one slot further round fleet.conf, so the rest are reached on later ticks (logged). Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_PROJECTS_PER_TICK:-0}; outside 0..100 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4584: the timeout on the ONE keyed conductor run (MC_ONLY_PR=<key> bin/merge-conductor.sh) queue-reconcile starts for a stale WAIT_CI row whose checks are all green; it starts only while the tick has this plus 60 s left. Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_KICK_TIMEOUT_S:-240}; outside 30..900 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4584: seconds a dispatched solo run (queue-culprit, pq_dispatch) may stay unanswered before its cache entry is written could-not-run (no verdict on that member). Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_SOLO_TIMEOUT_S:-2400}; outside 300..86400 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4584: how far back (by updated_at) a closed, unmerged mergify/merge-queue/* draft is read as a failed batch to solo-run. Read by bin/archie-fm-queue.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMQ_BATCH_WINDOW_S:-21600}; outside 600..172800 is one warn line and the default.
Not a knob: bin/archie-fm-queue.sh sets it to 1 when it re-execs itself under its backstop timeout (1860 s), so the child does not wrap itself again. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-fm-queue.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-fm-queue.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: seconds of the outer backstop timeout instead of 1860, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam gate: bin/archie-fm-queue.sh honours ARCHIE_FMQ_NOW and ARCHIE_FMQ_TICK_CEILING_S and sources ARCHIE_FMQ_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.

BH-5943: the oldest box settings cache (state/settings-cache.json, lane-gate's one list read a tick) the lane uses for archie.manage[.<project>] when the single-key read fails. The project then runs on the cached mode and the log says so; an older cache, or none, skips the project as before. 0 = skip the project as before BH-5943. Outside 0..3600 is one warn line and the default. 1200 is two ticks, so a kill switch archie.manage=off reaches a project at most 10 + 20 minutes after it is written.
